draft.margin: season value of the producer's pick minus the engine's, under the league valuation, from actual season totals; who else drafted the engine's pick does not matter

lineup.did_not_play: a missed game adds zero in every category, whatever the reason
lineup.margin: sum over the league's scored categories of (producer's player - engine's player) stats over the games each played in the period, divided by that category's per-game standard deviation; percentage categories as attempts x (rate - pool rate); a tie inside tie_band_per_sqrt_game x the square root of the larger of the two players' games in the period
lineup.scale: per-game standard deviations from the projection snapshot pinned before the season opener; never from preseason results
lineup.settles: after the scoring period (Monday to Sunday) ends, once the box scores of its games are on record

not_settled: confirmed decisions (the engine's pick stood): report card only

supersedes.reason: The league's own settings (records 2026-10-08) lock lineups weekly and score eight categories without turnovers; D41 assumed daily lineups.

waiver.margin: the lineup margin summed over the games in the window
